wj7phnzf.variantName: Christmas Tree World 10ft Pre-Lit Slim Wildhorn Pine - Warm White Lights
wj7phnzf.sourceDescription: Enjoy a festive glow with the 10ft Pre-lit Slim Wildhorn Pine. This elegant artificial Christmas tree combines lifelike pine needle foliage with 680 multi-function warm white LED lights in a slender shape, making it a lovely choice for rooms with high ceilings where floor space is limited. Featuring distinctive short-cut pine needle foliage, the Slim Wildhorn Pine has traditional PVC tips tucked towards the centre. These add depth and fullness, while the outer branches give a natural appearance. It offers a beautifully full look within a narrow silhouette. It has gently upswept branches and a slim, tapered shape, with natural green shades and subtle brown detailing. At 10ft tall, it brings impressive height to your festive display while leaving more room for your Christmas celebrations. Warm white LEDs highlight the needles, with multiple lighting effects to suit your display. The tree comes in four sections, with hinged branches for easy assembly and a supportive metal stand. Spread inner PVC tips before shaping the outer pine needle branches. Wear long sleeves and the included gloves when fluffing the prickly pine needles. Designed for indoor use only, with Christmas Tree World's 10-year foliage and branch guarantee and a 1-year guarantee on the lights. Please note: Accessories in the images are not included with purchase. pgvee4v3.sourceDescription: Brrr! Feel the frost take over your home this festive season with this high-quality Christmas garland! Subtly decorated with matte silver Christmas baubles, grey balls of yarn, frosted branch tips, white poinsettia, and fluffy white balls, it couldn’t be easier to fall in love with this 180cm decorated Christmas garland from Christmas Tree World! Please note: Frosted Mixed Pine wreath is not included. At 180cm, this festive garland is the perfect size for draping over mantelpieces, along staircases, and bordering doorways. A sight to behold all in itself, this garland really doesn’t need anything else to make it magical (although a few extra warm white Christmas LEDs do offer an extra dose of fairy dust!) Accessories shown in the images are not included with the item. The product is sold without any accessories. Read the operating instructions before use. Keep away from heat sources. Christmas Tree World, Unit 3, Enfield Industrial Estate, Enfield Street, Wigan, Greater Manchester, WN5 8DB, United Kingdom
